name: Tsujikura Spica
source: A mysterious girl who lives in a trailer house on the edge of town, and keeps her distance from the townspeople. Her job is to take care of the wheat fields and then use the harvested wheat to make the most incredible pizza. However, it is very difficult to get a taste of the food that she makes. She is not one to talk much, but is very kind towards animals and to the elderly. At night, she can often be seen playing her grass whistle in the wind.
